note: Cardiac and renal anomalies are well-established recurrent features of Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome and are frequently reported across clinical cohorts.

evidence.text: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome (STISS) is established to present with neurodevelopmental phenotypes alongside cardiac and renal malformations, which were confirmed and further expanded in a series of 24 additional patients.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: In addition to previously reported DD/ID, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, we also confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as a feature of this syndrome.

evidence.text: PSMD12 pathogenic variants causing Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome are associated with syndromic congenital heart defects and renal abnormalities.

source.title: Analysis of Copy Number and Sequence Variants Linked to Cardiac Development in Children with Syndromic Congenital Heart Defects
source.quote: that can also include renal and cardiac abnormalities [27]. The … deletions of PSMD12 cause Stankiewicz–Isidor syndrome
